verdict.rationale: Obsidian provides its own programmatic surfaces: a TypeScript plugin API with a Vault interface for working with files and folders, and an Obsidian URI protocol for triggering actions such as opening or creating notes. One community user confirms extracting metadata through the API. Nothing in the evidence shows parity with the UI. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, an external/remote API usable without running the app (the plugin API is in-process and URI actions are limited), coverage of features like Bases, Canvas, graph and settings via API, and independent corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Vault, the interface that lets you interact with files and folders in the vault.
Obsidian URI is a custom URI protocol supported by Obsidian that lets you trigger various actions, such as opening a note or creating a note.
Build plugins to extend the existing functionality in Obsidian using TypeScript.
The plugin community and API let the user extract metadata and publish metrics to CloudWatch
